title: A Study of Sovilnesib in Subjects With Ovarian Cancer
official: A Phase 1b Dose Optimization Study of Sovilnesib (an Oral KIF18A Inhibitor) in Subjects With Selected Advanced Solid Tumors
summary: This is a phase 1b study to assess the safety, tolerability, pharmacokinetics (PK), and preliminary efficacy of sovilnesib at different dose levels to establish the optimal dose of sovilnesib in subjects with selected advanced solid tumors.
conditions: High Grade Serous Adenocarcinoma of Ovary
criteria:
Key Inclusion Criteria:

* All Parts: Age ≥ 18 years, ECOG Performance Status ≤ 1, at least 1 site of measurable disease evaluable by CT scan or MRI per RECIST 1.1, able to take oral medication without alteration
* Histologically confirmed locally advanced, inoperable, or metastatic tumor.
* High Grade Serous Ovarian Cancer, Fallopian Tube or Primary Peritoneal Cancer - histologically confirmed; locally advanced, inoperable or metastatic; p16 positive (Part 2 only); platinum resistant (defined as radiographic progression/recurrence \<180 days after last dose of ≥ 4 cycles of platinum containing therapy) or refractory; prior bevacizumab treatment, unless ineligible or intolerant; if germline and/or somatic BRCA1/2 mutation, previously treated with PARP-inhibitor (unless ineligible or intolerant).

Key Exclusion Criteria:

* Part 1 only: MSI-H, dMMR, POLE gene hotspot mutated, or known hypermutator phenotype
* Endometrioid, clear cell, mucinous, sarcomatoid, low-grade/borderline ovarian tumor or mixed tumors containing any of the above histologies
* Previously received KIF18A inhibitor
* Leptomeningeal disease, or new or progressive CNS metastases or spinal cord compression
* Cardiac parameters: MI, PE, CABG, severe/unstable angina or stroke ≤ 6 months, NYHA Class ≥ II, LVEF \< 50%
* Any gastrointestinal condition (e.g. malabsorption syndrome, surgical anastomosis, short bowel syndrome) that might affect the absorption of oral medications including the study drug
